# Cycling assets

`owner-20261122-bandeamir-riders-hero.webp`: cyclists on a dirt track beside a lake and cliffs at Band-e-Amir, Bamyan. James-supplied photograph (t460u), used as the activity hero and card (16:9 crop). Credit: Photo: AfghanTours.

The previous `hero.webp` / `thumb.webp` (boys cycling in the Bamyan valley, 17 Jun 2012, Sgt. Ken Scar, U.S. Army, public domain) were moved to `unpublished-assets/cycling-replaced-20261122/` on 22 Nov 2026 and are no longer public site assets.
